name: Ego Browser
description: Let Finch browse the web in isolated Ego Lite task spaces while you follow every page it opens.
systemPrompt: Use ego_browser for browser automation with declarative actions. Call action=status first to inspect Ego and task spaces. Use open_url, snapshot, click, fill, type, press_key, scroll, screenshot, extract and close_space for everyday tasks, passing space_id from open_url/status when needed. Fall back to action=run only for advanced cases. Reuse task spaces, respect user ownership, verify meaningful actions, and complete spaces when done.
